results.title: Sandisk to Report Fiscal Third Quarter Results on April 30, 2026
Sandisk Corporation Common Stock (SNDK) Earnings Report Dates & Earnings Forecasts | Nasdaq

results.summary: Q3 FY2026 reported April 30, 2026. Q4 FY2026 (next earnings) expected ~August 13, 2026 (estimated window July 24 - August 3, 2026). Analyst EPS estimate for Q4: $31.51. Company guided Q4 to EPS $30-33 and revenue ~$8B.
